# Decisions

- 2026-10-10: Gradium via plain httpx REST, not the `gradium` SDK (async/websocket; avoids a new dependency).
- 2026-10-10: Scope = TTS + STT + credits + voices, CLI only. No UI, no API endpoint, no websocket streaming, no voice cloning.
- 2026-10-10: No retries or fallback; fixed error codes authentication_required / quota_exceeded / invalid_input / invalid_output / provider_unavailable; the key is redacted from messages.
- 2026-10-10: Limits: TTS text up to 5,000 chars, STT audio up to 25 MB, response up to 50 MB.
- 2026-10-10: voices() defaults include_catalog=true (the API default false returned 0 voices).
- 2026-10-10: Voice chat architecture: browser talks directly to Gradium WS with per-socket single-use tokens from the backend (per Gradium browser guide); the LLM reply goes through the backend (Gemini; Gradium has no LLM). Rejected: Gradbot (separate Python server, needs an OpenAI-compatible LLM) and a backend WS relay (more code, added latency).
- 2026-10-10: Models: Gradium STT `default`, TTS `default` (stable; `gradium-tts-beta` alias skipped). Voice Emma YTpq7expH9539ERJ (friendly/conversational tags). Gemini gemini-3.8-flash, thinking low, max 400 output tokens, 20 s timeout, 1 attempt.
- 2026-10-10: Single AudioContext at 24 kHz for capture (STT `pcm`) and playback (TTS `pcm_24000`). Turn end = 3 consecutive VAD steps with 1 s-horizon inactivity > 0.6, then flush.
- 2026-10-10: Voice UI hidden in publicMode/previewMode (the cloud API has no voice routes).
- 2026-10-10: User asked to keep the Gradium key in `.env.example` and to copy it to `.env` (not move it).
- 2026-10-10: Navigation = Gemini returns JSON {say, action}; named actions for screens/steps (find_set, open_tutorial, close_booklet, go_home, how_it_works, next/previous/go_to/replay_step, play_build). Server validates against catalogue + screen; `open_tutorial` without a loadable scene falls back to `find_set` with honest text.
- 2026-10-10: "All page navigable" (user): generic `click {control_id}` over controls listed by the browser (`apps/web/src/voice/controls.ts`), chosen over one named action per button (rejected: needs code per future button). User chose NO confirmation, even for prepare/automatic conversion/save/cancel.
- 2026-10-10: Controls: button, [role=tab], summary, a[href]; excluded disabled/inert/hidden/.voice-chat; scoped to open `dialog`; max 80; duplicate labels get `data-voice-scope` suffix (guide rows, preparation section). Form fields and selects excluded (find_set/go_to_step cover them).
- 2026-10-10: Viewer voice dock is collapsible (starts as a 56px mic button, bottom 128px) because the open card covered Next and review controls. Rejected: in-flow dock (workspace is a fixed 100dvh grid).
- 2026-10-10: Mute = `VoiceSession.setMuted()`: track.enabled=false + silence to STT; STT/TTS sockets stay open, thinking/speaking continue, typed input still spoken. Muting mid-utterance lets VAD end the turn (partial is answered, not dropped). Stop resets mute. Rejected: closing the STT socket (would need a new token + setup on unmute).
- 2026-10-10: After preparation without 3D, show rendered official pages (`components/PreparedPages.tsx`, img from `/api/v1/sources/{sha}/pages/{i}`, page count = job.total_units). Removed UI button "Try automatic conversion" (local API always 503). Kept original copy "The official pages are prepared. No 3D reconstruction…" (booklet-preparation.spec asserts it). Viewer placed outside the role=status job box.
- 2026-10-10: User declined in-app engine for now (pages only). If later wanted: "Build 3D candidate" via tools/engine.py with cap 100 Gemini calls per booklet (user's answer).
- 2026-10-10: LDConfig mismatch: user chose "find exact pinned file" over re-pinning. Source = official LDraw update archive lcad2605.zip. Provenance `url` kept as canonical official path (fetch_materials and engine alpha.py require it) plus `acquired_from` with archive URL, member, archive sha256 and reason.
- 2026-10-10: Dock is movable + minimizable (`voice/dockState.ts`, useSyncExternalStore, localStorage `guide2build.voiceDock` = {minimized, position}). Shared by dialog and viewer docks; default minimized at bottom-right. 9-dot grip (IconGridDots) drags via pointer capture; arrow keys move 24px (Shift 80px); clamped 8px inside viewport on resize/size change. Minimize works while voice is active (pill keeps state colours). Hero voice is not movable.
- 2026-10-10: Global `button:hover:not(:disabled)` (0,2,1) overrides plain `.x:hover`; voice button hover rules must use `:hover:not(:disabled)`.
- 2026-10-10: Control-collection tested in Playwright (real browser), not Vitest: no jsdom/happy-dom installed; did not add a dependency.

# Insights

- 2026-10-10: Gradium docs index is at https://docs.gradium.ai/llms.txt; the OpenAPI reference is embedded in the endpoint .md pages.
- 2026-10-10: GET /voices/ without include_catalog returns [] for this account (no custom voices).
- 2026-10-10: Gradium credit balance is free to query; 1 credit corresponds to a unit of generated audio (see the Credits guide).
- 2026-10-10: GET /api/api-keys/token -> {token (22 chars), expires_at ~60 s}; single use; WS URL wss://api.gradium.ai/api/speech/{asr|tts}?token=...
- 2026-10-10: STT WS messages: ready, text, end_text, step (vad horizons 0.5/1/2/3 s), flushed, end_of_stream, error. Client: setup, audio(base64), flush{flush_id}, end_of_stream.
- 2026-10-10: Gradium streamed WAV header has a placeholder length; read raw bytes after the `data` chunk.
- 2026-10-10: Gemini voice reply latency ~3.7 s (low thinking); this is the dominant turn latency.
- 2026-10-10: Playwright fake mic: --use-fake-device-for-media-stream --use-file-for-fake-audio-capture=WAV (loops; pad with silence). Browsers in var/ms-playwright (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH).
- 2026-10-10: The repo's run path needs uv plus Node >= 22.12; neither is set up on this machine.
- 2026-10-10: Without a `click` action Gemini honestly refused ("tap the prepare booklet button"); fixed list of actions = refusals for every unlisted button.
- 2026-10-10: All 10 catalogue sets have tutorial_available=false locally; scene endpoint 409. Synthetic fixture route-mocking (tests/e2e/viewer.spec.ts pattern) is the only way to test in-tutorial UI.
- 2026-10-10: A fixed overlay dock intercepted clicks on viewer Next and "Advanced corrections" (Playwright "subtree intercepts pointer events"). Run the software e2e suite after any floating UI change.
- 2026-10-10: "Review candidate" button relabels to "Close review" when open; assert the "Review workspace" dialog instead.
- 2026-10-10: Playwright 1.63 `page.routeWebSocket(/api\.gradium\.ai\/api\/speech\/asr/)` fakes Gradium offline; `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` mic gives non-silent PCM (useful to prove mute sends only zeros).
- 2026-10-10: LDraw update archives: https://library.ldraw.org/library/updates/lcadYYMM.zip (list at /updates); LDConfig.ldr appears only in updates that change it (lcad2605 for UPDATE 2026-05-29). The live official LDConfig can change without a header date change (2026-10 added !AVATAR lines).
- 2026-10-10: Programmatic element.click() after an await works for buttons/tabs/summary; popups from target=_blank links may be blocked.

Demo script: ask for a model by voice, open the ingested plane (30669/alt-02), "I'm stuck at step 5, walk me through the next 3 steps" (animation plays while each step is narrated), rotate by voice.
